description: NightCash is the fungible worked example of this repository: a demonstration asset on a Nyctis channel over a local Zcash test network, 8 decimals, capped at 100,000,000 display units by a number hashed into its own identity. The document exists to exercise asset-metadata-v0 end to end — a pinned logo, a description, and links a wallet renders only after the user accepts the asset.
